audio.text: Are you going to Maya's presentation this afternoon?

options: She presented her research last semester.
I wouldn't miss it. She's been practicing all week.
It's in the afternoon, I think.
The room only holds about forty people.

why.en: Indirect "yes". A shifts the time; C just repeats "afternoon".
why.tr: Dolaylı "evet". A zamanı kaydırıyor; C sadece "afternoon" kelimesini tekrar ediyor.
